subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should authorized `agents_list` callers receive trimmed nonblank `agents.list[].description` values for visible agents?
rationale: The remaining code change is small, but it exposes free-form operator-authored config metadata through a model-facing tool result, which repository policy treats as a maintainer-owned boundary.

options.title: Accept narrow output
options.body: Expose only trimmed nonblank descriptions for agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked PR for merge.

options.title: Gate or narrow output
options.body: Require an explicit visibility setting or narrower caller boundary before returning configured descriptions.

options.title: Reject core exposure
options.body: Keep descriptions as config-only metadata and close or supersede the linked PR in favor of a broader roster or prompt design.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow output
recommendation.body: Expose only trimmed nonblank descriptions for agents already visible through `agents_list`, then refresh and review the linked PR for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced `agents_list` and has the strongest feature-history signal for the multi-agent discovery boundary.
